proposals.evidence: The entire response is big/elder + brother. Turner 10187 branch 11 gives western moṭā/moṭũ big, with local l-extensions retained, and 9661 gives bhāi/bhāu brother. These are two ordered components; the final ś/s/h in individual survey forms is preserved as local morphology rather than silently removed.
